summary: Only 11 m of kerb on a steep bend; too short for a van.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 18 m north and homes all round; trees on the south side.
drivers.access_and_room: Line is 11 m long on a narrow lane at a corner, with fence or bush at the edge and no verge or pull-off.
drivers.convention: No signs; no cars parked on this lane.

sun_shade: Mixed tree canopy, mainly from the south.
